title: Skinned rig face: m96 pixel parts on 3D head anchors (round 3 + round 4: 8 directions, dash/hurt, critic nits)
question: Owner: 'the faces are all messed up, need to follow the head's movements, follow the 3D model, more expressive depending on the action.' Can hand-designed m96 face parts placed per frame on projected 3D head anchors replace the baked/projected face?
method: face/face_lib.py: the approved m96 eye/brow/mouth/blush/nose templates (eye_spec.json via eyetmpl.py) plus 12 named expressions (neutral, smile, smile_open, joyful, determined, effort, surprised, squint, wink, blink, half_blink, shout) and a narrowed far eye. face/f_render.py (Blender, wraps R's render_motion.py): a faceless head pass, and the m96 anchor pixels ray-cast onto the rest head, kept in head-bone space, re-posed and projected every frame. face/face_layer.py (P's call): the face zone is re-taken from the faceless head; one integer face offset with hysteresis; per-part relative residuals with dead bands; eye-row split on roll; far eye far->far3->hidden or opened by yaw; eyes slide inside the outline; brows/mouth/blush only on skin. Expressions come from M's per-frame face/blink/mouth keys. The preview gets a half-pixel face composite. Run with face/f_run.sh.
result: Works on walk/run/idle/jump x SE/E/S (M's 21:33 bake, R's r6). The anchors reproduce the master at rest exactly (0 px); calibration = R's lift_px (S 4, SE 3, E 1 px). Relative part changes per frame: walk/jump SE/E 1-2 of 8-15; S/idle/run SE 5-7 (real roll/yaw). Every GIF is loop=0 with frames >= 20 ms. Round 4: brows gap the fringe, gritted-teeth effort mouth, far eye off the cheek outline. Faces in all 8 directions: NE/NW partial (blush + lash tip), N none, W/SW/NW mirrored (mirror test: NW 0 px, SW only the iris/catchlight). New expressions: focused (dash), hurt, wince, hurt_tear, strain. Native 8 directions (R r7): calib W/SW/NW = mirrored E/SE/NE exactly; verified on native SW/W/NW renders (fixed a W profile eye dropout caused by sub-cm occlusion noise). Dash "focused": 2-row lower lid + brow-into-lash wedge.
verdict: Both critics: a clear fix for the smeared face. The face follows the head and the jump reads as a story. Remaining: one-frame idle smile (M), brow/fringe contact on V-brows, a muddy effort mouth, far-eye lashes touching the cheek outline in walk SE f03-f05, and the E-profile nose missing in run E (head geometry).
